title: Context and memory in an agent

items.stem: Dana trained on the laser cutter last Tuesday. Today she opens a new session of an assistant built as a plain agent loop with a model, tools and no code that saves anything. She asks, "Am I cleared for the laser cutter?" Which statement is true?

options.text: The model recalls Tuesday's session, because it keeps every session it has had
The model cannot see Tuesday's session unless your program saves it and supplies it
The model recalls Tuesday's session if the context window is large enough
The model recalls Tuesday's session because tools keep a log of conversations

items.stem: An agent's system prompt and tool definitions total 3,000 tokens and the student's question is 100 tokens. The model is called three times: the first two calls each end with a 50-token tool request, and each tool returns a 2,000-token result that your program appends to the context; the third call writes the final answer. Ignoring caching, how many input tokens are sent in total across the three calls?
Your makerspace has a 300-page manual set, and a student asks how to change a band saw blade. Which design gives the model what it needs at the lowest recurring cost?

options.text: Put the full manuals in the system prompt so every call can see them
Rely on what the model learned in training about band saws in general
Give the model a search tool that returns the few best-matching chunks
Replace each manual with a one-line summary kept in the system prompt

items.stem: In one or two sentences: why would a long-running agent write notes to a file rather than rely only on its context window?
An agent's context holds 60 earlier tool results and is still well under the window's limit. The relevant fact is in result 7. What problem can still occur?

options.text: The API returns an error because the context is already too long
The model stops calling tools because older results are locked
The oldest results are dropped silently before the model sees them
The model may recall the fact less accurately as the context grows
